claims.head: The Blues have changed
claims.body: Over this season and last, the Blues have been around the middle of the league for shot volume. This season alone they’ve been around the middle of the league, shooting more. We think tonight looks more like this season than the old Blues.
claims.nums: Shot volume: 19th over two seasons (55.2 per 60), 11th this season (58.1 per 60)
claims.gist: The Blues aren’t the team you remember for shot volume.
claims.call: The Blues’ shot volume is better than their blended level of 55.2 per 60.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · blended and this season only · 4 games this season

check.rule: held if tonight's figure lands on this season's side of the blended level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: The Blue Jackets’ power play outclasses the Blues’
claims.body: The Blue Jackets are around the middle of the league for the power play, at the lethal end; the Blues are the league’s worst, at the harmless end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.gist: The Blue Jackets and the Blues sit at opposite ends for power play.
claims.call: The Blue Jackets’ power play creates more per 60 than the Blues’.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 3 and 4 games this season

check.rule: held if the team comes out ahead by at least half its usual margin; partly if it comes out ahead by less; otherwise didn't happen

notes.text: Z. Werenski is out long term (shoulder injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
I. Provorov is on injured reserve (lower body injury) and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. C. Soucy has taken his spot beside D. Mateychuk.
D. Severson returned in their last game after missing 2 games.
D. Heinen has started killing penalties: on the ice for 32% of the team’s shorthanded time in 3 games, up from 5% last season.
T. Tucker is out indefinitely and has not played this season. He is one of their more valuable skaters. B. Carlo has taken his spot beside C. Fowler.
L. Mailloux is out long term and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. A. Jiricek has taken his spot beside P. Broberg.

STL.head: Leaning St. Louis’s way
STL.body: Columbus has had more of the chances over recent games, Columbus is playing for the second night in a row, and St. Louis has home ice. Not by much, though: Columbus can make it interesting if their penalty kill holds up.

CBJ.head: Columbus starts a half-step behind
CBJ.body: Columbus has had more of the chances over recent games, Columbus is playing for the second night in a row, and St. Louis has home ice. Columbus can tip it if their penalty kill holds up.
